subtype: Approach: talking to a registered adviser [Action]
passage:
Thursday, evening.
Went to see Gurleen today, a registered adviser who charges a fee only, no commission. I was nervous and had a page of questions.
Gurleen said at the start she couldn't tell me what to do with my money. What she could do was explain how general options work: how the time I need the money changes what makes sense, what fees do over the years, and what "rebalancing" means. I wrote it all down.
It was an odd feeling: less like getting orders, more like being taught.
I'll go through the notes on my own this week and decide after that. I'm calmer than I was this morning.
— Parveen
